description: A request whose optional `advanced` block is serialized as an explicit `null` rather than omitted. That is the same request as one with no `advanced` at all: it must decode to the absent state and resolve to the same one-pass plan (AC 1 / AC 2). A producer predating sc-20415 is free to emit either shape, so rejecting `null` here would retroactively invalidate payloads that were valid when they were written.
